query.title: Query
query.description: The code or description you asked for.

status.title: Status
status.description: found (charged), not_found, invalid_input, service_unavailable, skipped_charge_limit. Only found rows are charged.

matchType.title: Match type
matchType.description: code (the exact line), code_child (a line under the code), keyword (all key words matched), keyword_partial (best partial match).

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Position within this query's results (1 = best).

level.title: Level
level.description: chapter, heading (4 digits), subheading (6), tariff_line (8, where duty rates are set) or statistical (10, used on customs entries).

fullDescription.title: Full description
fullDescription.description: Breadcrumb from the heading down to this line, joined with " > ".
examples: T-shirts, singlets, tank tops and similar garments, knitted or crocheted: > Of cotton > Men's or boys': > Other T-shirts: > Men's (338)

generalRate.title: General duty rate
generalRate.description: Column 1 General (normal trade relations) rate, inherited from the parent 8-digit line when the 10-digit line has none.

specialRate.title: Special rate
specialRate.description: Column 1 Special rate with program codes (FTAs and preference programs).

specialPrograms.title: Special programs
specialPrograms.description: Program codes parsed from the special rate.

column2Rate.title: Column 2 rate
column2Rate.description: Column 2 rate (countries without normal trade relations, e.g. Cuba, North Korea, Russia, Belarus).

rateSource.title: Rate source
rateSource.description: this_line, or which parent line the rates were inherited from.

units.title: Units
units.description: Units of quantity for statistical reporting.

additionalDutyRefs.title: Chapter 99 references
additionalDutyRefs.description: Chapter 99 provisions this line (or its parents) points to: htsNumber, appliesTo (general/special/column2), description, rate.

examples.rate: The duty provided in the applicable subheading + 35%

htsRelease.title: HTS release
htsRelease.description: USITC release the data came from.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: Link to this code on hts.usitc.gov.

closestHtsNumber.title: Closest code (misses)
closestHtsNumber.description: For a code that does not exist: the closest existing parent code.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why a row was not found or not run.
